messages.subject: renderDataTable callback confusion
parts:
Hi all ---

When I draw a DataTable object via renderDataTable and pass a callback argument, shouldn't the callback function get called once the table 'exists' (i.e. is fully loaded in the DOM)?

renderDataTable(foo, options = list(callback = "function(oTable) { alert('foo!'); }"))

I expect to see an alert raised by the above method, but no alert is ever triggered.
Exactly when is the callback executed? (and then, for what purpose, if not manipulating oTable after loading?)

Cheers!

-m

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: renderDataTable callback confusion
parts:
The callback argument of renderDataTable() was invented because it is
not straightforward for users to manipulate the DataTables object
created (you can certainly use jQuery to do it anyway). It is purely a
workaround in Shiny and has nothing to do with DataTables API. The
DataTables API is reflected in the options argument.

Regards,
Yihui
